V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Dining area under pergola is bounded by house, wall, and planting; fire pit area is bounded by house, wall, and dense planting; standing/BBO area is bounded by house, wall, and paving edge.

V-FOCAL.evidence: Fire pit, dining table, and pond court are all prominent and visually compete for attention; no single element clearly dominates as the primary focal point.

V-AXIS.evidence: Gravel and paved areas connect the house doors to the fire pit, dining table, standing/BBO area, and seating. All circulation paths terminate at defined functional zones or features.

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Large mass of citrus/small trees in the bottom-left corner, a distinct group of four trees in the top-right, and a row of small shrubs along the bottom edge.

V-LAYERING.evidence: Bottom-left corner shows a large canopy tree circle overlapping medium small-tree circles and lighter shrub circles, creating distinct vertical layers.

V-ROOMS.evidence: Multiple distinct zones with different floor surfaces: gravel seating/fire pit area, paved dining area under pergola, paved standing/BBO area, and a separate herbs bed.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear zoning into distinct rooms (dining, fire pit, standing/BBQ, pond court), defined edges via walls and paving, and structured planting masses (Citrus, herbs, pond court trees).
